purpose: Rejoin a successfully committed revision dispatch execution receipt into the exact originating ResolutionEvidenceInbox as observation-only evidence after proving correspondence with the current ResponseIntent, dispatch request, and revision-chain post-state.

input_boundary.inbox: exact-subject ResolutionEvidenceInbox used by the originating response path
input_boundary.chain: current ResolutionRevisionChain containing the committed revision

validation: originating ResponseDispatchRequest preflight must still be ready against the same inbox and intent
request, response-intent, and dispatch fingerprints must exactly match the receipt
receipt lineage, revision key, and optional parent must exactly match the request payload
receipt authority tuple must remain explicit_caller_invocation + authorization_claim none + mutation committed
receipt revision-count delta must be exactly one
receipt_fingerprint is recomputed from the canonical v1 receipt fields
current revision chain must have the same lineage and contain the committed revision with matching key and parent
current revision chain may have advanced after this receipt, but it may not be older than the receipt post-state

interpretation.request_information: not derived from a committed execution receipt
interpretation.propose_revision: not derived from a committed execution receipt
interpretation.note: independent review/revision APIs remain available for other reasons

resolution_effect.note: the source execution already created the revision before rejoin; recording its receipt must not create another revision

identity.receipt_fingerprint: recomputed fnv1a64 correlation fingerprint using the same canonical fields as the execution adapter
identity.security: correlation and tamper-consistency check only; not cryptographic authentication or authorization

invariants: a valid receipt cannot be rebound to an arbitrary RuntimeSubjectProjection
subject binding is inherited internally from the exact inbox target only after request/intent/chain correlation succeeds
receipt rejoin never opens another revision
receipt rejoin never upgrades ResolutionRevisionChain source authority into Resolution decision authority
committed execution evidence does not automatically generate another propose_revision candidate
future_extensions: execution receipts for runtime verifier adapters
higher-level cycle correlation across multiple authority executions
